codeLevelWitness.note: The implementer cannot run a real browser; the forwarding-drop is re-confirmed at the CODE level against the resolved reka-ui dist + a deterministic jsdom MOUNT born-RED witness (which IS the falsifiable RED — it dispatches a real pointerdown on the SAME DOM node the user presses).

rekaSliderRootForwarding.finding: SliderRoot renders `createBlock(CollectionSlot, …, createBlock(resolveDynamicComponent(SliderHorizontal|SliderVertical), mergeProps(_ctx.$attrs, { ref: forwardRef, onPointerdown: _cache[0], onSlideStart, … })))`. A consumer `@pointerdown` arrives as `$attrs.onPointerdown` and is merged with reka's OWN cached `onPointerdown` (_cache[0]) then forwarded DOWN through SliderHorizontal → SliderImpl → Primitive. Across the CollectionSlot + resolveDynamicComponent + forwardRef chain the consumer handler is shadowed — it never reaches the rendered DOM node.

rekaSliderImplDomListener.finding: The DOM-attached pointerdown is reka's own _cache[1]: `target.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); event.preventDefault(); … emits('slideStart')`. This is the handler that actually binds to the host node; the consumer's forwarded $attrs handler is not on it.

preFix.witness: At HEAD the mount gate is born-RED for the RIGHT reason: a real pointerdown dispatched on the resolved [data-slot=slider] host yields keepOpen() expected +0 to be 1 (the template @pointerdown never fired through reka's forwarding); a real touchstart likewise expected +0 to be 1; end-to-end against the REAL <GlassDock> provide, data-held expected false to be true on the dock root. The dispatch DOES reach the node (a manually-added native listener fires), proving the device-bisection: the event reaches the host; only the Vue template binding is dropped.

secondLatentDefect.name: keepDockOpen default never applied (absent-boolean-cast trap)
secondLatentDefect.finding: Independent of the forwarding-drop, the documented `Default: true` for the `keepDockOpen` boolean prop NEVER reached the common no-prop call site (the demo + every real consumer). Vue casts an ABSENT boolean prop to `false` (not `undefined`), so `props.keepDockOpen ?? true` resolved to `false` and DISARMED the hold by default. Even with a working binding, the hold would not have armed. Collapsed by W03 via `withDefaults(..., { keepDockOpen: true })`.
secondLatentDefect.device: isolated jsdom probe — armed=false with no prop; armed=true with explicit :keep-dock-open="true"

postFix.mechanism: useDockHold(resolveHost) — native addEventListener('pointerdown'|'touchstart') on the RESOLVED reka forwardRef host (getRootEl()), window-scoped pointerup/pointercancel release, onBeforeUnmount teardown, useOptionalDockContext() DI (keepOpen/release/held). One owner, one acquire path. The dead <SliderRoot> @pointerdown/@touchstart template bindings + the duplicated acquire/release booleans + the parallel watch(touchGate.isActive) acquire path are DELETED.
postFix.mountGate: GREEN — 3/3: pointerdown acquires keepOpen()+lights data-held; window pointerup releases+clears; touchstart drives the SAME single acquire (no parallel path); end-to-end data-held paints on BOTH the dock root and the slider root.
